content: The training set contains only crowdsourced annotations. To label the training data, we use a 10-fold validation like setting. We iteratively retrain the LSTM-CRF-Pattern sequence tagger of Patel et al. patel2018syntactic on 9 folds of the training data and use that trained model to predict labels for the 10th. In this way we obtain predictions on the full training set. We then use predicted spans as proxy `ground truth' annotations to calculate the difficulty score of sentences as described above; we normalize these to the [ $0, 1$ ] interval. We validate this approximation by comparing the proxy scores against reference scores over the test set, the Pearson's correlation coefficients are 0.57 for Population, 0.71 for Intervention and 0.68 for Outcome.
